name: create-survey-solicitation
narrative: Maya has just finished designing her Round 6 study — the two-arm Attakar-versus-Gura household survey that her Vitamin-A programme will use to check whether its visits are actually changing coverage. She has the plan; what she does not yet have is the independent survey firm to run it. So from the plan she just built, Maya clicks "Create solicitation" and lets the plan itself become the call for a firm. On the create form the R6 plan is already waiting as the coverage area, so Maya only sets the survey scope, marks the call active, and publishes it — minting a brand-new solicitation live, on camera, no fixed record reused. A survey firm then opens that exact public solicitation, reads the coverage on offer, ticks the Attakar-and-Gura area as the work its enumerators can staff, and submits its application. Back in her workspace, Maya opens the responses for the call she just published and sees the applying firm tied to the exact coverage area she designed — the loop from a study plan to a real applicant closed, minted fresh each render. Awarding that firm and standing up the live Connect opportunity her enumerators would actually run is the step Maya is reaching for next; today she has recruited and can compare applicants against the real coverage.

firm.name: Sahel Field Research
firm.intro: Sahel Field Research is an independent northern-Nigeria household-survey firm looking for survey work it can staff; it answers public solicitations with the coverage its enumerators can commit to. It names itself in the response form's "Your organization" block, so the owner reviews and awards a named firm rather than the individual account that submitted the application.

maya.name: Maya
maya.intro: Maya designed the Round 6 two-arm Attakar-versus-Gura study for her Vitamin-A programme and now needs to recruit the independent firm that will run the household survey on it.

slides.title: The goal — recruit an independent firm to run the study
slides.narration: Maya has designed her matched study. But to measure her own program credibly, the survey has to be run by someone independent. So she needs to recruit a survey firm — to visit the households and collect the outcomes. Rather than start a separate process, she turns the finished study into a call for a firm on the Connect network, with the wards, coverage, and scope already attached.

slides.title: Maya turns her finished study into a call for a firm
slides.narration: Maya's finished Round 6 study sits in her portfolio, flagged ready to solicit — and right on the card is the way to turn that plan into a call for a survey firm, no separate tool.

slides.title: Maya mints the call live and lands on its responses page
slides.narration: Maya builds the call. The title, scope and coverage carry over from her study. She adds a description, the type, timeline, scale and contact - the call can go out publicly across the whole Connect network, or be pointed at organizations she already knows work here - and she writes an application question for the firms.

slides.title: Maya generates the scoring criteria with AI
slides.narration: Then, instead of hand-writing a scoring rubric, she clicks Generate with AI - and the platform drafts the evaluation criteria, weighted, straight from her scope and questions. She reviews them, and publishes the call.

slides.title: A survey firm reads the open call and ticks the area it can staff
slides.narration: A survey firm opens the call. The scoring criteria Maya generated show right beside each question, so the firm knows exactly how it will be judged - and it drafts its answer.

slides.title: The AI coach sharpens the firm answer
slides.narration: Before submitting, the firm runs the draft through the AI Application Coach - which reviews it against those same criteria and suggests where to strengthen it. The firm picks the coverage it can staff, and submits.

slides.title: Maya sees the firm tied to the coverage she designed
slides.narration: Back in her workspace, Maya opens the responses and sees Sahel Field Research tied to the exact coverage she designed.

slides.title: Maya awards the firm and sees it was notified
slides.narration: She awards Sahel Field Research — the screen records the decision and notifies the organization. Standing up the live opportunity is the next step, not yet built.
